lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Tata, look at the door. Deedee measured me two times since you left.
lines.script: [proud, showing off] Tata, look at the door. [matter-of-fact] Deedee measured me two times since you left.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: I got one too. Mine's the low one.
lines.script: [proud, bouncy] I got one too. [proud] Mine's the low one.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Twenty years ago I'd have caught that thing before it got to the fence.
lines.script: [boastful, wistful] Twenty years ago I'd have caught that thing before it got to the fence.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Tom. You stay in front of those girls.
lines.script: [serious, fatherly] Tom. [serious] You stay in front of those girls.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: A WHAT climbed in my window?
lines.script: [shocked, incredulous] A WHAT climbed in my window?

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: It has EYES! The mud has EYES!
lines.script: [horrified, shrill] It has EYES! [shrill, urgent] The mud has EYES!

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Forty years in this kitchen. I've had ants. I've had a raccoon. I have never had THAT.
lines.script: [outraged, deadpan] Forty years in this kitchen. [outraged] I've had ants. I've had a raccoon. [shocked] I have never had THAT.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: It's so brown. It's the brownest thing I've ever seen.
lines.script: [disgusted, dramatic] It's so brown. [dramatic] It's the brownest thing I've ever seen.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: It's running for the pond!
lines.script: [urgent, alarmed] It's running for the pond!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It talks.
lines.script: [flat, unsettled] It talks.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: It talks AND it steals.
lines.script: [exasperated, dry] It talks AND it steals.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: I've been bitten ten thousand times in my life. Not one of them ever said a word first.
lines.script: [offended, dry] I've been bitten ten thousand times in my life. [deadpan] Not one of them ever said a word first.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Then nobody goes near the water. Stay close.
lines.script: [firm, quiet] Then nobody goes near the water. [firm, caring] Stay close.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: A MARBLE! There's a marble with a bug in it!
lines.script: [delighted, squealing] A MARBLE! [delighted] There's a marble with a bug in it!

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: That's a dragonfly. It's inside an orange rock. Its wings are open and it's not moving.
lines.script: [careful, serious] That's a dragonfly. [careful] It's inside an orange rock. [quiet, curious] Its wings are open and it's not moving.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Look at the grass. It's grey. Just this bit, the size of my hand.
lines.script: [puzzled, sharp] Look at the grass. [sharp] It's grey. Just this bit, the size of my hand.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It isn't dried out. It's just grey. Like somebody took the green out.
lines.script: [uneasy, quiet] It isn't dried out. [uneasy] It's just grey. [thoughtful] Like somebody took the green out.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: I'm keeping it. It's stuck.
lines.script: [determined, pouting] I'm keeping it. [frustrated] It's stuck.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Let me.
lines.script: [calm, patient] Let me.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: You're not trying.
lines.script: [accusing, pouty] You're not trying.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I'm trying, Rose. It's a marble and it's winning.
lines.script: [dry, patient] I'm trying, Rose. [dry, amused] It's a marble and it's winning.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: There's a little round hole in the side. Like somebody took a bite.
lines.script: [curious, careful] There's a little round hole in the side. [amused] Like somebody took a bite.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: And somebody left a burnt light bulb. Now they're littering at my pond too.
lines.script: [annoyed, sharp] And somebody left a burnt light bulb. [indignant] Now they're littering at my pond too.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: The tin. Go, go, go.
lines.script: [urgent, commanding] The tin. Go, go, go.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: Bye, marble. I'm coming back for you.
lines.script: [sweet, determined] Bye, marble. [determined] I'm coming back for you.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's a fish. That fish is bigger than the cab.
lines.script: [stunned] That's a fish. [awed] That fish is bigger than the cab.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Boppy was RIGHT?
lines.script: [stunned, bossy] Boppy was RIGHT?

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Nobody tell him.
lines.script: [whispering, conspiratorial] Nobody tell him.

lines.speaker: The Big One
lines.text: This morning I was a fish. Then there was a big flash. Now I am a BIG fish. With a hat.
lines.script: [bubbly, amazed] This morning I was a fish. [awed] Then there was a big flash. [proud] Now I am a BIG fish. [delighted] With a hat.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Tom, you stand in front of whoever it stares at. Cozy Rosie, make it laugh. Then we try again.
lines.script: [firm, commanding] Tom, you stand in front of whoever it stares at. [firm, encouraging] Cozy Rosie, make it laugh. [determined] Then we try again.

lines.speaker: The Big One
lines.text: And this is for the small one. It's my shiniest thing.
lines.script: [shy, warm] And this is for the small one. [proud, warm] It's my shiniest thing.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: It has a bug on it! I'm keeping it.
lines.script: [delighted, squealing] It has a bug on it! [determined] I'm keeping it.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: This one you can keep.
lines.script: [warm, generous] This one you can keep.

lines.speaker: The Big One
lines.text: The old man with the cap. Is he coming tomorrow?
lines.script: [hopeful, shy] The old man with the cap. [hopeful] Is he coming tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Boppy? He comes every day.
lines.script: [matter-of-fact] Boppy? He comes every day.

lines.speaker: The Big One
lines.text: Good. Don't tell him I asked.
lines.script: [sheepish, whispering] Good. [sheepish] Don't tell him I asked.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Boppy, the mud TALKED. And the mosquitoes. And a puddle.
lines.script: [breathless, excited] Boppy, the mud TALKED. [excited] And the mosquitoes. And a puddle.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: The mud talked? Forty years in this town, the mud never said one word to me.
lines.script: [incredulous, playful] The mud talked? [complaining, playful] Forty years in this town, the mud never said one word to me.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: He gave me a present. Look.
lines.script: [proud, excited] He gave me a present. [excited] Look.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: That's real gold, Cozy Rosie. Gold like my teeth. Look.
lines.script: [proud, playful] That's real gold, Cozy Rosie. [proud, joking] Gold like my teeth. [playful] Look.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: Boppy has treasure in his mouth!
lines.script: [delighted, gasping] Boppy has treasure in his mouth!

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: You put that somewhere safe. Gold is for keeping.
lines.script: [serious, fatherly] You put that somewhere safe. [wry] Gold is for keeping.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Next time something comes in that window, I'm coming. Stomach or no stomach.
lines.script: [determined, playful] Next time something comes in that window, I'm coming. [complaining, wry] Stomach or no stomach.
